<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Diplomatic protocol:</strong> The Ministry of External Affairs has signaled that Punjab CM Bhagwant Mann should not visit Lahore, citing the necessity for all officials to adhere to established national policy regarding Pakistan.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election reform:</strong> National discourse is intensifying over the potential implementation of &#x27;One Nation, One Election&#x27; as a solution to the challenges posed by the current election calendar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Counter-terror strategy:</strong> The Ministry of Home Affairs has unveiled &#x27;PRAHAAR&#x27;, marking India&#x27;s first comprehensive national counter-terror policy.</li>
  <li><strong>Trade relations:</strong> The New Zealand Parliament has officially cleared a Free Trade Agreement with India, signaling a strengthening of bilateral economic ties.</li>
  <li><strong>Judicial review:</strong> The Supreme Court is currently reviewing significant matters, including the two-child norm and a petition from Yes Bank regarding the AT-1 bond order.</li>
</ul>
